address: viale Bigioli 47, San Severino Marche, 62027, Italy
bio: Situated on the main street passing through the town, this bright, relaxing and well-soundproofed restaurant on the first floor is run by two brothers – one at the helm in the kitchen and the other front of house. While continuing the family tradition, the brothers also serve the type of cuisine that they prefer, namely fish and seafood in dishes that are both classically prepared and substantial. The menu also offers good alternatives for meat-lovers....
